title: Add tests for a pending prepared begin's re-acknowledgement meeting WriteFailed (stays pending) and WorkerStopped (withdrawn into the hold)
outcome: Two scripted-writer tests cover the untested pending-kind branches of prepare_engram_begin_durable. First, Deadline then WriteFailed: the same key, grant and tokens stay pending, and no rebind happens. Second, Deadline then WorkerStopped (or Shutdown/Superseded): the record is withdrawn, the begin_preparation_unacknowledged hold is set, and nothing is sent.
acceptance: Add tests for a pending prepared begin's re-acknowledgement meeting WriteFailed (stays pending) and WorkerStopped (withdrawn into the hold) is done
